it.text: Per fare il grā canale, fa prima il piccolo e dalli l'acqua, che colla rota farà il grāde.

en.text: To make the great canal, first make the smaller one and conduct into it the waters which by a wheel will help to fill the great one.
en.label: Translation: Jean Paul Richter, 1883
